title: ARS Editor Agent — Output (successEdl | errorEnvelope)
description: Validates the polymorphic v1.0 output of the Editor Agent (Agent #10 of 17 — first EXECUTOR agent in the post tail, 10th defense-in-depth firewall pass at COMMIT time on the committed passthrough-text surface, second contractually mode-BLIND agent). Authored Day 71 (Mon Jun 29 2026) from SPEC §3 Outputs (Day 66 outline) + §6.3 9-code/slot-11 errorEnvelope mapping (Day 67 §6.3 LOCKED) + §10 Field Map 26 rows + §10.4 schema authoring note (Day 67) + §12 deterministic AND-of-gates verdict math (Day 68) + §16 metadata block (Day 68). Polymorphism via top-level oneOf (mirrors AI Video Gen Day 14 + Style Replication Day 33 + QC Pre-flight Day 45 + Ingest Day 54 + Edit Director Day 62 pattern — 6th reuse). DEFINING DIVERGENCE — the FIRST fleet agent to DROP a verdict its direct predecessor carries: verdict enum is ['edl_ready','fail'] — exactly TWO values, NO 'revise'. Editor is a fully-DETERMINISTIC executor (a timecode is in range or it isn't; copy is byte-faithful or it isn't; a transition is a cut or it isn't; the firewall is clean or it isn't), so there is NO subjective conform surface and NO held-creative-call verdict. successEdl <=> verdict 'edl_ready'; errorEnvelope <=> verdict 'fail'. Human deferral lives in human_review_required const true + render_target.conform_mode const 'human_in_the_loop' on EVERY emission (recommend-don't-render), NOT in a verdict branch — the subjective surface lives ONE stage upstream (Edit Director's one 'revise' slot), where the creativity is. The success branch encodes the §12 AND-of-gates HARD terms as const invariants (conform_check all-booleans const true, plan_fidelity_check all-6-booleans const true, edl_firewall_pass_10 status const pass + hits const 0, events[*].transition const 'cut', caption_events[*].text maxLength 22, lower_third_events[*].case const 'lowercase' + align const 'left', end_card_event.hold_ms const 1500, edl.frame_rate const 30 + aspect const '9:16' + resolution const '1080x1920', render_target.render_dispatched const false + conform_mode const 'human_in_the_loop', mode_blind_confirm.production_mode_read const false) — making a false-edl-ready STRUCTURALLY impossible (false-edl-ready tolerance ZERO target, §8). 9 LOCKED failure codes (§6.3) + slot-11 catch-all editor_agent_failed enumerated via enum; asset_unresolved is enumerated as a single FOLDED code (cut-asset + music-bed + voice-track resolution all route back to Ingest) and plan_fidelity_breach as a single FOLDED code (hash-tamper + copy/order deviation all route back to Edit Director) — the deliberate OPPOSITE of Edit Director keeping duration_envelope_breach standalone (per D8: Editor's defect surface clusters by ROUTE-BACK DESTINATION, not by defect taxonomy). render_dispatched const false (Hard Rule #3 — authors an EDL, renders nothing; the human conforms in v1.0; Week 4-5 automation is v1.1). edl_evidence_hash + plan_evidence_hash pattern ^[a-f0-9]{64}$. asset_uri ^ars:// platform-relative (Hard Rule inherit). human_review_required const true on EVERY branch (recommend-don't-render — Hard Rule #13). QUADRUPLY-DEFERRED (Decision D7): parent_chain held additively (minItems 5, prefixItems 0-8, maxItems 9, items false) — accepts the 5-tuple, the 6-tuple QC extension preview, the 7-tuple Ingest extension preview, the 8-tuple Edit Director extension preview, AND the 9-tuple Editor append. TODO@cross-spec-3.9-ratification: flip to minItems 9 (exact-9) ONLY after the Cross-SPEC §3.9 n-tuple amendment ratifies AND the Edit Director 8-tuple LOCKs AND the Ingest 7-tuple LOCKs AND the QC Pre-flight 6-tuple LOCKs. The 9-tuple is the one item NOT auto-advanced this run (Editor is the FOURTH forcing function for the amendment).

successEdl.description: verdict == 'edl_ready' branch (§3.1) — the ONLY success verdict (NO 'revise'; the defining divergence from Edit Director). Emitted ONLY when every HARD AND-of-gate term is true (§12 deterministic AND-of-gates, zero tunable thresholds): Edit Director precondition met AND plan_evidence_hash verified AND all assets resolved AND all timecodes in range + frame-aligned AND timeline gap-free + no double-spend AND transitions hard-cuts-only AND duration in band AND committed copy byte-faithful AND the 10th-pass commit-time firewall clean (hits==0). The hard gate terms are schema-pinned as consts below, so a false-edl-ready (a clean envelope alongside a failing hard sub-status) is STRUCTURALLY impossible (false-edl-ready tolerance ZERO). human_review_required is const true even on edl_ready (an edl_ready = 'ready for the human conform', NEVER 'rendered' or 'approved' — Hard Rule #13). Any HARD defect routes to the errorEnvelope branch instead (verdict 'fail').

verdict.description: The ONLY success verdict. NO 'revise' (the executor is deterministic — the defining divergence from Edit Director's ['plan_ready','fail','revise']). The two-verdict enum ['edl_ready','fail'] manifests across the two oneOf branches.

edl.description: §10 rows 12-18 + the format header — the canonical Edit Decision List. The 9:16 / 1080x1920 / 30fps format spec (Brand-Voice Intake §8) is encoded as const at the schema layer (the conform target is canon, not folklore). events[] is the conformed cut timeline; caption_events/lower_third_events/end_card_event/music_event are the committed-copy + placement events.

events.description: §10 rows 12-14 — the conformed cut timeline. Each event: shot_ref + asset_uri passthrough; src_in/out_ms TRANSFORMED to frame-aligned source timecodes (validated <= declared duration); rec_in/out_ms the gap-free record-timeline positions (each rec_in_ms == prior rec_out_ms); transition const 'cut' (hard-cuts-only at the event layer).

caption_events.description: §10 row 15 — committed caption events. text BYTE-FAITHFUL from the plan (NOT re-authored — Hard Rule #9); text maxLength 22 (the brand rule, machine-enforced); at_ms on the conformed timeline.

lower_third_events.description: §10 row 16 — committed lower-third events. content BYTE-FAITHFUL; case const 'lowercase' + align const 'left' (the brand rules at the event layer).

music_event.description: §10 row 18 — the music bed at t0 (asset_uri passthrough, must have resolved against asset_bundle). Swell positions are markers only — Sound (#11) finalizes the mix, NOT Editor.

end_card_event.description: §10 row 17 — the committed end card. line BYTE-FAITHFUL; hold_ms const 1500 (the brand end-card hold).

line.description: BYTE-FAITHFUL from the plan end_card.line (a deviation => plan_fidelity_breach).

plan_precondition_check.description: §10 row 21 — the precondition evidence (Step 1 / Checks #1+#2). edit_plan_id is the conformed plan; verdict_observed == 'plan_ready' OR lever3_signoff_present == true was required to proceed (else the run halted upstream_plan_not_ready).

conform_check.description: §10 row 22 — the conform-integrity adjudication (Steps 4-5,9 / Checks #4+#5). ALL booleans const true on the success branch (gate terms — Check #4/#5): any false routes to the errorEnvelope (timecode_out_of_range / timeline_gap_or_overlap). duration_in_band == (45000 <= total_timeline_ms <= 75000), const true on success.

timeline_gap_free.description: const true on success. false => timeline_gap_or_overlap (errorEnvelope, route Edit Director).

all_events_bounded_by_declared_duration.description: const true on success. false => timecode_out_of_range (errorEnvelope, route Edit Director).

frame_aligned.description: const true on success (every event on the 30fps grid).

total_timeline_ms.description: The conformed runtime; in-band by construction on success.

plan_fidelity_check.description: §10 row 23 — the byte-faithful executor invariant (Steps 3,6-9 / Check #7). ALL 6 booleans const true on the success branch (gate terms): any false => plan_fidelity_breach (errorEnvelope, route Edit Director). This is the structural proof Editor authored NOTHING — every committed field matches the plan byte-for-byte, the cut count matches, the transition policy holds, and the plan anchor re-verifies.

transition_policy_hard_cuts_only.description: const true on success. false => transition_policy_violation (errorEnvelope, route Edit Director).

plan_evidence_hash_verified.description: const true on success. false (tamper) => plan_fidelity_breach (errorEnvelope, route Edit Director).

edl_firewall_pass_10.description: §10 row 24 — the 10th-pass firewall result at COMMIT time on the committed passthrough-text surface (every caption event + lower-third event + the end-card — the last text checkpoint before pixels, Step 8 / Check #9). hits MUST be 0 on the success branch (gate term); any hit => edl_firewall_breach (errorEnvelope, route Edit Director — the highest-stakes code: a leak here burns into the cut). passthrough_text_fields_scanned = the true committed-field census.

tier_richness_echo.description: OPTIONAL §10 — the echoed planned-variant count. v1.0 conforms ONLY the primary 9:16 (variant_edls[] reserved v1.1+). Echo only, NOT a conform of the variants.

variant_edls.description: RESERVED v1.1+ (§10.2) — the auto-conformed aspect-variant EDLs (1:1 LinkedIn cutdown, etc.). Empty / absent in v1.0 (a cutdown is a derived re-conform, lower-leverage than the primary — Open Question 5, deferred).

human_review_required.description: const true even on edl_ready — an edl_ready is 'ready for the human conform', NEVER 'rendered'/'approved' (Hard Rule #13 — recommend-don't-render).

errorEnvelope.description: verdict == 'fail' branch (§3.2). The §6.3 LOCKED namespace: 9 substantive codes + slot-11 catch-all editor_agent_failed. asset_unresolved is FOLDED (cut-asset + music-bed + voice-track resolution — all route to Ingest) and plan_fidelity_breach is FOLDED (hash-tamper + copy/order deviation — all route to Edit Director); the deliberate OPPOSITE of Edit Director keeping duration_envelope_breach standalone (D8 — Editor folds by shared route-back destination). NO 'revise' here — Editor has no third verdict. human_review_required const true.

failure_code.description: The §6.3 LOCKED namespace: 9 substantive codes + slot-11 catch-all editor_agent_failed (Cross-SPEC §3.6). asset_unresolved is FOLDED (all asset-resolution failures route to Ingest); plan_fidelity_breach is FOLDED (hash-tamper + copy/order deviation route to Edit Director) — the OPPOSITE of Edit Director's standalone duration_envelope_breach (D8: fold by shared route-back). edl_lineage_failure = forensic halt (Check #10). editor_agent_failed accompanies attempts==2 (self-QC 2-strike exhaustion). NO 'revise' — Editor is two-verdict.

failed_check_id.description: Which §6.1 self-QC check produced the verdict (1..11 — the 11-check list, bipartite-covering the 9 codes + slot-11).

attempts.description: Self-QC 2-strike ceiling (§6 retry policy). attempts==2 accompanies editor_agent_failed (slot-11). No third attempt.

route_back_to.description: §3.2 / §12.2 verdict<->route map. ingest-agent on an asset-resolution gap (asset_unresolved — cut-asset / music-bed / voice-track); edit-director-agent on a conform-vs-plan defect needing a re-plan (timecode_out_of_range, timeline_gap_or_overlap, transition_policy_violation, plan_fidelity_breach, edl_firewall_breach — the committed copy is the plan's, so the leak/breach routes to the author); null on a halt that no upstream is at fault for (the precondition halts upstream_plan_not_ready + upstream_not_success, the forensic edl_lineage_failure, and slot-11 editor_agent_failed — the agent's own self-QC failure).

detail.description: Free-form failure context (the specific violation, affected_events, recovery_path, upstream_failure, the out-of-range cut on a timecode_out_of_range, the unresolved asset_uri on an asset_unresolved, the deviating field on a plan_fidelity_breach, the committed field + banned token on an edl_firewall_breach, etc.). Advisory recovery_path is surfaced, NOT auto-executed (v1.0 routes; it does not re-conform).

edlEvent.description: A conformed cut event. shot_ref + asset_uri passthrough; src_in/out_ms frame-aligned source timecodes (src_out_ms > src_in_ms, src_out_ms <= declared duration); rec_in/out_ms gap-free record positions; transition const 'cut'.

asset_uri.description: Platform-relative ars:// (Hard Rule inherit). Passthrough from cut_order — no absolute URL introduced.

src_out_ms.description: Frame-aligned; src_out_ms > src_in_ms AND <= declared media duration (else timecode_out_of_range).

transition.description: const 'cut' — hard-cuts-only at the EDL-event layer (a demanded non-cut => transition_policy_violation).

text.description: <=22 chars — the brand caption rule, machine-enforced at the EDL-event layer. BYTE-FAITHFUL from the plan (a deviation => plan_fidelity_breach).

content.description: BYTE-FAITHFUL from the plan (a deviation => plan_fidelity_breach).

case.description: const 'lowercase' — the brand rule at the event layer.

align.description: const 'left' — the brand rule at the event layer.

modeBlindConfirm.description: Root-level mode-blind self-attestation (§16 companion — NOT in metadata). Editor is the SECOND contractually mode-blind agent — the proof Ingest's convergence seam holds two stages deep. production_mode_read const false (Hard Rule #7); consumed const 'mode_agnostic_edit_plan'.

renderTarget.description: Root-level render-target self-attestation (§16 companion — NOT in metadata). The machine-checkable no-render / human-in-the-loop guarantee at the executor seam (the field Edit Director's schema flagged as 'flips relevance at Editor' — v1.0 keeps it false). render_dispatched const false (Hard Rule #3); conform_mode const 'human_in_the_loop'; v1_edit_uri reserved (the human writes the v1.mp4 path on conform — active write deferred to v1.1 Week 4-5 automation).

render_dispatched.description: const false in v1.0 — Editor authors an EDL, renders nothing; the human conforms (Hard Rule #3). Automation is v1.1.

conform_mode.description: const 'human_in_the_loop' in v1.0; 'automated' reserved v1.1 Week 4-5.

v1_edit_uri.description: RESERVED v1.0 (null/placeholder — the human writes the v1.mp4 here on conform). Populated as a real render handle only when Week 4-5 automation ships (v1.1).

reelRefFull.description: §10 row 11 — the derived reel reference triple (the cross-record audit join keys). edl_id is this agent's emitted identity.

reelRefMinimal.description: Minimal reel reference on the errorEnvelope branch (§3.2) — at minimum the emitting agent's own identity.

editPlanId.description: Edit Director's emitted identity (UUIDv7 per Cross-SPEC §3.9 ID canon) — the consumed plan + parent_chain[7] (the 8-tuple element). UUIDv7 validates under the uuid format.

edlId.description: This agent's emitted identity (UUIDv7 per Cross-SPEC §3.9 ID canon) — also appended at parent_chain[8] (the 9-tuple extension, held additively). UUIDv7 validates under the uuid format.

preflightReportId.description: QC Pre-flight's emitted identity + the 6th parent_chain element. v1.0: ^preflight-REINVENTED-YYYY-MM-DD-NNN$ (multi-brand v1.1+ widens the prefix).

qcPreFlagsEmitted.description: Editor's own emitted predicates (§3.7 snake_case, >=4 — Check #11). e.g. timeline_gap_free, hard_cuts_only_conformed, commit_firewall_clean_pass_10, mode_blind_conformed. Appended to the upstream union without modifying it (§10.3).

sessionId.description: Accepts Cross-SPEC §3.9 UUID(-v7) canon OR the established ars-/sess- prefixed forms (additive, backward-compatible). Single combined pattern avoids oneOf/format ambiguity (format is annotation-only under Draft 2020-12 default assertion behavior).

parentChainHeld.description: QUADRUPLY-DEFERRED (Decision D7 / §10.4 / §16 addition 1). The 9-tuple, HELD ADDITIVELY: prefixItems positions 0-8 = [brief_id, script_id, storyboard_id, production_plan_id|rendered_shots_set_id|mode-c-direct, replication_set_id, preflight_report_id, asset_manifest_id, edit_plan_id, edl_id]. minItems 5 ACCEPTS the 5-tuple inbound canon (pre-ratification); maxItems 9 ACCEPTS the 6-tuple QC extension preview, the 7-tuple Ingest extension preview, the 8-tuple Edit Director extension preview, AND the 9-tuple Editor append; items false. REJECTS a 4-tuple. positions 0-7 inherit the Edit Director parentChainHeld verbatim; position 8 is Editor's append (edl_id, UUIDv7). This is the one item NOT auto-advanced this run (Editor is the FOURTH forcing function for the amendment).

metadataBlock.description: Cross-SPEC §3.9 canonical block + 6 Editor additions (§16): edl_class, edl_evidence_hash, render_dispatched (const false), conform_mode (const human_in_the_loop), runtime_environment_class, edl_id. human_review_required const true (Hard Rule #13). render_dispatched const false is the declared-no-render honesty contract — an EDL CLAIMING a render it never produced is forged provenance (Hard Rule #3). production_mode is PRESENT for audit lineage but the sibling root-level mode_blind_confirm attests it was never READ (Hard Rule #7).

production_mode.description: PRESENT for audit lineage; NOT read as a branch (Hard Rule #7). The sibling root-level mode_blind_confirm.production_mode_read:false attests it was never consulted.

cost_incurred_usd.description: ~$0 — conform reasoning + EDL authoring only (Cross-SPEC §3.9). $0 engine + $0 render + $0 decode invariant (ties Ingest / QC Pre-flight / Edit Director for lightest in the fleet).

latency_ms.description: Reasoning-only; target p50 <= 25000 / p95 <= 75000 (§8 — lighter than Edit Director's authoring).

edl_class.description: Addition 1. v1.0 = primary_9x16; variant_cutdown reserved v1.1+ (§16).

edl_evidence_hash.description: Addition 2. SHA-256 (lowercase hex, 64) over the edl + conform_check + plan_fidelity_check block (§6.1 #11 / §3.2). Tamper-evident conform; the audit anchor + recomputability basis for recommend-don't-render.

render_dispatched.description: Addition 3. const false in v1.0 — the declared-no-render honesty contract (Hard Rule #3). Editor authors an EDL, renders nothing; the human conforms. Mirrors the root-level render_target.render_dispatched.

conform_mode.description: Addition 4. const-equivalent ['human_in_the_loop'] in v1.0; 'automated' reserved v1.1 Week 4-5. Mirrors the root-level render_target.conform_mode.

runtime_environment_class.description: Addition 5. Inherited from AI Video Gen §16.

edl_id.description: Addition 6. This agent's emitted identity (UUIDv7) — mirrors reel_ref.edl_id and parent_chain[8].
